purpose: Conversation and per-message gates plus progressive minimum context.
use: Start of each conversation and each user message: pass the entry and interaction gates, resolve language and load minimum context.
semantic_conditions: Applies to new, resumed and recovered chats alike; conversation age grants no exemption.
mandatory_preconditions: Workspace binding, adopted identity and resolved presentation language.
postconditions_verification: Request classified and applicable closure loaded before substantive work.
